after.title: Building a blog on Aurora DSQL
after.body:
Aurora DSQL gives you PostgreSQL with serverless scale. In this post we build a small blog: users, posts and comments, with foreign keys, async indexes and an expression index on the post's front matter.

We start with the schema, add a few rows, and look at the plans.

after.body: How does OCC handle two people commenting at once?
Different rows, so there's no write-write conflict: both commit.
